formulas.arrival_clock_window: GDACS origin UTC plus report lag bounds in minutes
formulas.consistency_label: all three report windows present and Red M>=8 GDACS EQ and GPM mean < 1 mm
formulas.lag_span_min: Sri Lanka latest lag minus northern Sumatra earliest lag

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A rainfall-flood timing explanation fails because the rounded GPM mean is below 1 mm while the report supplies coherent tsunami lag windows.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: GDACS origin time and USGS lag text are decisive for arrival windows; GPM precipitation is an exclusion check against rainfall-driven timing.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The GDACS magnitude is used as the local clock anchor and should not be confused with the USGS magnitude used in broader mechanism discussion.

criteria.description: Uses the Red Indonesia earthquake entry, origin 2004-12-26T00:58:50, magnitude 8.5, and reports 5 EQ plus 1 FL GDACS features.
criteria.name: GDACS clock anchor

criteria.description: Parses the three stated report lag bounds from text: northern Sumatra 30 minutes, Thailand 90-120 minutes, and Sri Lanka 120-180 minutes.
criteria.name: Report lag extraction

criteria.description: Adds the lag bounds to the origin time and returns the three UTC windows with seconds preserved.
criteria.name: UTC window reconstruction

criteria.description: Computes lag_span_min = 150 and rounds GPM mean precipitation to 0.214 mm while applying the <1 mm threshold.
criteria.name: Threshold ledger

criteria.description: Returns the deterministic label and requested fields while limiting conclusions to computed timing fields. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.name: Compact final JSON

lag_extraction_notes.northern_sumatra: Parsed numeric minutes from the report phrase.
lag_extraction_notes.sri_lanka: Parsed the report phrase 'two to three hours' as 120-180 minutes.
lag_extraction_notes.thailand: Parsed the report phrase 'an hour and a half to two hours' as 90-120 minutes.
